excludedMaterials.Sepang1401Mtl: grey driving strip; used only to infer side

method.side: source grey driving strip occupancy along projected right vector; lateral fallback
method.opacity: ignored for baked shading in kerb atlas; only horizontal red/white faces included
method.adjustment: Longitudinal position, side and colour are projected onto the frozen CSV centreline; kerb width/profile follow the widened flat layout.

runoff.method: Sample each runoff colour band outward from the model driving-strip boundary; exclude areas nearer a different track section and relocate the boundary to the wider flat road edge. Pale textured runoff is represented as gravel.
